speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I see you are presenting with rectal bleeding and a palpable rectal mass. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as constipation or diarrhea, and has your stool become narrower or pencil-like?

speaker: Patient
text: 45-year-old female. The patient reports a 2-week history of rectal bleeding occurring daily with bowel movements. She denies any pain with defecation and does not present with any other complaints.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rectal Cancer. The patient's age, daily painless rectal bleeding, and palpable mass are highly suggestive of malignancy. I recommend an immediate colonoscopy and biopsy for confirmation.
